name: Party Command Queue
description: Holds a short FIFO of intended orders for each party member while continuous time is paused, then releases them in a deterministic party order. It owns intention lifetime — append, reject, clear, and cancellation on defeat — not movement, casting, cooldowns, or AI. Every released order becomes utility.commandRequested on the existing Command Bus; there is no private path into a caster or walker. Resume is the default release edge, while explicit-submit mode supports games that pause and release as separate decisions.

inputs.name: maxOrdersPerMember
inputs.description: Maximum pending orders for one member. Zero disables queuing; the cap prevents an unbounded pause from becoming an unbounded burst.

inputs.name: allowOrdersWhileRunning
inputs.description: Whether new intentions may be appended without pausing. Release still follows releaseOn.

inputs.name: releaseOn
inputs.description: resume releases when tactical pause changes to running; submit releases only on input.submitCommands.

inputs.name: clearOrdersOnDefeat
inputs.description: Remove orders owned by a defeated member and orders whose explicit target was defeated before either can dispatch.

outputs.name: pendingByMember
outputs.description: FIFO orders keyed by party-member id, including stable order ids and payload data.

outputs.name: pendingCount
outputs.description: Total queued orders across all members.

outputs.name: nextOrderFor
outputs.description: Read the next pending order for one member without releasing it.

provenance: BG2-inspired extraction pass on 2026-11-02 searched Command Bus, Behavior FSM, Robot Command Queue, Command Round, Hotbar Abilities and Party Formation. Command Bus orders already-emitted requests, Behavior FSM produces AI intentions, robot commands are actuator-specific, and Command Round locks simultaneous turn commands. None owned per-party-member FIFO intentions across a continuous-time pause, so this fills that gap while preserving Command Bus as the only dispatch channel.
